title: Serpent Sorceress Ritual
description: A blue-skinned woman with vibrant green and red swirling hair stands at a wooden alchemical desk, holding a glowing orange ethereal snake. Behind her hangs a large tattered tapestry depicting a massive multicolored serpent coiled around bottles and symbols. The desk is covered with potion bottles, lit red candles, blue feathers, a bowl of thorny branches, and a bottle labeled 'POISON'.
prompt: A blue-skinned mystical woman with swirling green and red hair stands in a dimly lit arcane study, wearing a cream toga. She holds a glowing orange ethereal snake in her palm. Behind her on a peeling blue wall hangs a large weathered tapestry showing a giant multicolored serpent coiled around potion bottles. A wooden table in front is filled with glass bottles, a poison bottle, lit red candles dripping wax, blue feathers, and a bowl of thorny branches. Hanging lanterns illuminate the scene.
